phases.title: Wire SortSelect to FilterContext (remove localSortBy, use setSortBy from context)
phases.notes: Removed localSortBy state and SortOption import from ProductListPage. Added setSortBy from useFilterContext(). Wired SortSelect to sortBy/setSortBy from context. SortSelect context migration tests pass. Build succeeds.

phases.title: Wire ProductCard category button to FilterContext.setCategory (remove onCategoryClick prop from ProductCard and ProductList)
phases.notes: Added useFilterContext import to ProductCard; removed onCategoryClick from Props and destructuring; replaced onCategoryClick?.(product.category) with setCategory(product.category). Removed onCategoryClick from ProductList Props and stopped passing it to ProductCard. Also removed onCategoryClick={() => {}} from ProductListPage (absorbed phase-3 work because TypeScript refused to compile with a prop that no longer exists on ProductList). All 21 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Clean up ProductListPage (remove no-op onCategoryClick prop passed to ProductList)
phases.notes: Absorbed into phase-2: ProductListPage no-op onCategoryClick prop was removed as part of fixing the TypeScript compile error caused by removing the prop from ProductList.

phases.title: Run tests and verify build passes
phases.notes: All 21 tests pass (7 test files). Build succeeds: tsc type-check clean, vite build produces dist/ with no errors.
